title: activitypub.rs featured() does redundant account lookup
description: src/activitypub.rs:593-599. The featured() handler calls fetch_account() on line 594 (which queries the DB and returns ApAccountRow), then immediately calls get_persona_id() on line 597 (another DB query for the same username). The first query already verifies the account exists and could provide the ID, making the second query unnecessary. fetch_account() returns ApAccountRow which does not include the persona ID, but the persona lookup happens twice — once inside fetch_account (via fetch_ap_account) and once via get_persona_id.
